text: hey we have some props but we need more props more props in  the game. i need things like: road cones, trees (lots of tree shapes), rocks (lots of rocks !!), balls (collision physics!), wall props like a wall painting or a led light, chairs, couch, a ton of things! can you do some
resolution: Added 25 new prop kinds across the full pipeline: street furniture (trafficCone, jersey barrier, trashCan, park bench, planter), 6 tree shapes (oak/pine/birch/cypress/palm/dead — trunk-sized collision so you walk under the canopy), 5 rock forms (boulder/flat slab/spire/mossy/pile), 3 balls (beach/soccer/basketball — solid colliders the player bumps; rolling/kick dynamics is a separate future system since props are static world geometry today), wall props (framed wallPainting, glowing ledLight — anchor at wall base, decor hangs at height), and furniture (chair, couch, table, floorLamp). Each kind has: registry definitions in BOTH cart/hmsc-int/world/propKinds.ts and game/kinds/props.ts, a live Scene3D model (new Tree/Ball/WallDecor/Furniture/StreetFurniture model files + Rock variants), compiled instance-part recipes in compile/worldGeometry.ts so compiled maps get real models not blocks, build-catalog material/cover/depth tags (auto-appears in the build palette), and yaw-aware thin segment collision generalized from fence to barrier/bench/couch. Verified: kinds/props suite 8/8, build suite 18/18, all affected carts bundle clean.
